The Financial Stability Oversight Council, a panel of U.S. regulators formed in the aftermath of the 2008-09 financial crisis, will adopt a new approach to assessing threats to financial stability, Bessent wrote in a letter he posted on social media.  Bessent said the council, which he chairs, will now prioritize economic growth and security and pinpoint ways to ease regulation through its work.
